description: This file defines classes and functions for transforming requests and responses for Voyage's contextualized embeddings API. It includes configuration, request mapping, response parsing, and error handling specific to Voyage embeddings.

classes.name: VoyageError
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors related to Voyage API responses.

classes.name: VoyageContextualEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Voyage contextualized embedding API, providing URL construction, parameter mapping, environment validation, request and response transformation, and error handling.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL based on provided base URL and endpoint path.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI parameters for Voyage embeddings.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI style parameters to Voyage-specific parameters.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates and prepares environment-specific headers, notably adding the authorization token.

methods.name: dict transform_embedding_request( self, model: str, input: Union[AllEmbeddingInputValues, List[List[str]]], optional_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms input data into the format required by the Voyage embeddings API.

methods.name: EmbeddingResponse transform_embedding_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: EmbeddingResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_key: Optional[str] = None, request_data: dict = {}, optional_params: dict = {}, litellm_params: dict = {}, )
methods.description: Parses the raw HTTP response from Voyage into an EmbeddingResponse object, extracting usage and other metadata.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Returns an exception class instance for representing API errors.

methods.name: bool is_contextualized_embeddings(model: str)
methods.description: Checks if the given model name indicates a contextualized embeddings model.
